newsitem.title: JAPAN: RUSSIAN PGM AUG SHIPMENTS ARRIVE IN JAPAN--TRADERS.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIAN PGM AUG SHIPMENTS ARRIVE IN JAPAN--TRADERS.

text.p: Deliveries of both platinum and palladium (PGMs) from Russia for August under long-term contracts arrived in Japan on Friday morning, traders said.
"August PGM shipments from Russia arrived today. This time, the shipments were smoother than expected," one trader at a major trading house said.
An official of a major bullion house also said the arrival of both metals on Friday was earlier than expected.
Traders expected both metals to flow into the Japanese market next Monday.

Traders said, however, that tightness in the physical palladium market may continue for at least the next two months as most of the metals would go straight to end-users. The platinum market has not been as tight as that of palladium.
Russia resumed PGM shipments to Japan under long-term contracts in July after a six-month suspension.
Russia supplies more than 60 percent of the world's palladium and about 20 percent of its platinum.
